questions.question: Do you (mainly) target end-customers (B2C), other businesses (B2B), governments (B2G) or donor organizations (B2D)?
Which customer segments do you target and how many have you served in the last calendar year (per customer type)?
Have you conducted a needs assessment of your end users and adapted your offers according to the results? If yes, describe what you did.
How large is your current SAM (serviceable target market) in terms of total number of customers?
What assumptions went into your SAM projections?

How large is your current target market in terms of revenue you can generate per year in US$ equivalent? (# of your potential customers multiplied by the average annual revenue generated per customer)
Which factors drive the development of your market?
Is your business model built around product(s), service(s) or a combination thereof?
Which of the following statements best describes the status of your most advanced product or service?
Who are your competitors (both direct and indirect), and what solutions do they offer?
How do you differentiate yourself from your competition?
Have you established clear pricing of your products or services?
Do you (plan to) generate repeat sales or regular revenues from your customers?
Do you have a marketing plan and budget?
Do you use a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system?
Do you have documented customer testimonials?
Since when are you generating regular revenues from the sales of your product(s) and/or service(s)
How much revenue have you generated during the last financial year (total turnover) in USD?
How much revenue have you generated from direct sales during the last six months?
Have your revenues continuously increased each month during the last six months?
How much profit or loss do you currently generate per customer with your most profitable product and/or service?
When do you plan to break even?
How accurate has your sales forecast been in the past 6 months?
Why is your business model innovative and how does it uniquely solve your customers problem compared to the alternatives?
Do you combine sales of your main product or service with complementary operation and maintenance or after sales services (that your competitors do not offer)?
Does your business model (at least in part) build on a solution that has proven successful in other sectors but has not been applied in your target market / sector?
Intellectual property: Have you patented your product(s)?
What innovative aspects of your business model (could) make your business model scalable?
What partnerships are key to scale your business model and impact? (please list them and explain what is the value proposition and incentives you offer them)
Are you tackling any of the following barriers with your business model?
Do you offer innovative payment options (rate payments, success based payments, buy now pay later, etc.) that enable your customers to buy your product and/or service? If yes, please specify
Have you conducted an analysis of the most cost intensive steps in your value creation chain and taken action to reduce costs in the past year?

Have you identified priority areas to improve the QUALITY of your production / delivery processes (e.g. improving the quality of the products or services or reducing negative environmental impacts of your production)? If yes, please specify:
In which of the following areas do you outsource value creation (at least partly)?
Do you engage / collaborate with customers in the value creation of the products/services your business offers? If yes, please specify:
Do you have a comprehensive, up to date business plan document?
Have you established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and targets for your business? If yes, please share your KPIs and related targets for the current calendar year
How (and how often) do you use and monitor progress against your KPIs and related annual targets?
Which are the key risks your business is facing that could keep you from meeting your targets and what mitigation measures have you established?
Have you assessed regulatory market barriers for your business? If yes, please specify which ones.
What are your risk mitigation / coping measures to deal with any potential future financial distress?
Do you have an updated and detailed financial plan available?
Do you have a cash flow / liquidity management system?
For how many years can you produce audited financial statements?
Do you have a 1-3 page back-up documentation of your  financial model on your unit cost of your product/service available?
Total amount of grants received to date [in USD equivalent]
Total amount of debt investment raised to date [in USD equivalent]
Total amount of equity investment raised to date [in USD equivalent],
Total amount of further investments (grants, debts, equity) under negotiations at the moment [USD equivalent]
Has your business incurred any liabilities due to providing collateral for loans or other financial obligations?
Has your company already been valuated by a third party?
For how long is your liquidity secured?
What is the amount of investments (not revenues!) do you seek to raise in the COMING twelve months?
How much of the investment do you plan to use for what and what do you seek to achieve?
What type of investment do you seek?
How many founders does your start-up have?
Has at least one of the founders founded another enterprise before this one?
Please provide an example of a mistake that happened during the past six months that you (and your team) learned from:
For how long can you as a (team of) founder continue to work on your start-up with the salary level you are currently paying yourself(ves)? (insert # of months)
How many people formally work in your enterprise in total (including founders, management and staff on a payslip)?

On average, how much practical experience do the operations managers have related to relevant technological aspects and work in the sector you target (e.g. water, sanitation, hygiene, waste, agriculture, etc.)?
On average, how much practical experience does your management team have related to financial management?
On average, how much practical experience do sales managers in your team have related to sales?
On average, how much practical experience do marketing managers in your team have related to marketing?
On average, how much practical experience do operations managers in your team have related to production processes?
On average, how many years of practical experience does the management team / founder(s) have in managing teams?
What is the highest level of external experiences and capacities that you can rely on?
Are written agreements in place with key suppliers (e.g. for molds, etc.) and business partners?
Have you faced any supply gaps / interruptions that led to delays in your production or delivery of your product(s) or service(s) in the past six month?
Have you established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for your key operational processes?

Have you established all the necessary key resources to fully deliver your offering? (For product-based businesses, this includes fully functioning production facilities. For service-based businesses, this includes having the required people and resources in place).
By how much could you increase your production / delivery of services in the coming three months without additional external investments?
As which type of legal entity have you established your business?
Do you have all required permits, licenses and approvals to operate?
Do you have written job descriptions for all team members?
Have you established a clear performance management framework to ensure accountability and appropriate compensation?
Do you have a succession plan for key positions?
Have you established a board that oversees the company and management team?
Please explain how you generate impact
Which of the following statements applies best when it comes to development problems you are tackling and your vision for solving them?
Is your business model contributing to any of the following aspects?
Have you defined impact related performance objectives or targets for this year? If yes, please share them.
Do you have an impact model or theory of change?
How regularly do you review your impact strategy and impact (performance) objectives?
Are the impact objectives part of the business performance evaluation?
How do you measure / monitor your impact?
If different from customers: What is the total number of people benefiting from your product(s) and/or service(s)
What percentage of your customers / beneficiaries are female?
What percentage of your beneficiaries are from vulnerable groups (for example BoP, people from rural communities, people with disabilities, children, the elderly, refugees, etc)?
What is the core impact focus of your business?
SDG 4: Total number of people [#] that acquired knowledge and skills needed to promote sustainable development through your business to date
SDG 5: Total number of women [#] in management positions in your business
SDG 5: Total number of women [#] in workforce (full-time equivalent), employed at equal pay in your business
SDG 8: Total number of jobs [#] created (full-time equivalent) through your business
SDG 8: Total number of jobs [#] created (full-time equivalent) in low-income areas, among disadvantaged groups, incl. minorities, refugees through your business
SDG 8: Total number of additional people [#] that generate income through your business without a proper employment
SDG 6.1: How many people received NEW ACCESS to safe and affordable drinking water to date due to your business?
SDG 6.1: How many people received IMPROVED OR MORE AFFORDABLE access to safe and affordable drinking water to date due to your business?
SDG 6.2: How many people received NEW ACCESS to adequate and equitable sanitation and hygiene to date through your business?
SDG 6.2: How many people received IMPROVED OR MORE AFFORDABLE access to adequate and equitable sanitation and hygiene to date through your business?
SDG 6.3: How much wastewater (in cubic meters) has been NEWLY treated because of your business to date that would otherwise not have been treated?
SDG 6.4: How much water (in cubic meters) has been saved or newly generated because of your business to date that would otherwise not have been saved / available?
How many people received new access to female health and hygiene products to date through your business?
How many people received improved or more affordable access to female health and hygiene products to date through your business?
SDG 2: Total quantity [tonnes] of food produced through your business to date
SDG 7: Total number of people [#] (e.g. farmers, producers, etc.) using water- or energy-efficient innovations or solutions thanks to your business
SDG 11: How much ORGANIC waste (in tons) has been newly treated because of your business to date that would otherwise not have been treated?
SDG 11: How much INORGANIC waste (in tons) has been newly treated because of your business to date that would otherwise not have been treated?
SDG 12: Total mass of avoided resource waste [tonnes] through prevention, reduction, recycling and reuse through your business to date
SDG 13: Total mass of avoided greenhouse gas emissions [tonnes] through your business to date
Based on your data collection methods, how likely is it that your business has difficulties compiling reliable, high quality impact data?
Considering your efforts to engage and consult beneficiaries and partners, how likely is it that your business misunderstands or not sufficiently considers their needs and expectations?
How likely is it that your business may prioritize revenue generation over impact because your impact is not locked into the enterprise model?
How likely is it that external events (beyond the control of the business, e.g. elections, disasters, economic crisis, etc.) disrupt your ability to deliver the envisaged impact?
How likely is it that the positive impact the business is generating may not last or that negative impact (e.g. waste) is not mitigated?
What is the negative social or environmental impact of your business and how do you (plan to) mitigate it?

source.built_from: EDS Word exports (content-control tags = Dataverse column names), 60 files validated 2026-10-18
notes: Score columns loaded 2026-10-18 (Power Query: all columns); names resolved to model names
Answer column stores the readable value; redit_/cr87e_ prefix columns store option codes (see option_labels.json)
Impact_SDG2 is scored out of 0.3; every other rated question out of 1
